recipe.visualDefinition: A studio portrait of three individuals (two men, one woman) in dark, textured clothing against a neutral gray background, featuring large-scale, high-contrast serif typography that overlaps the subjects' torsos.
coreVisualRelationships: Subjects arranged in a tight, triangular cluster to imply unity.
Text layered between the foreground and midground subjects to create depth.
High-key lighting on faces contrasting with deep shadows in black clothing.
Neutral gray backdrop providing a clean canvas for white graphic elements.
coreInvariants: Desaturated color palette leaning toward monochrome.
Sharp focus on facial features and hair texture.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Three subjects positioned centrally, waist-up, filling approximately 70% of the vertical frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central female subject's face, framed by the two male subjects.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the faces, moves down to the large display text, then follows the smaller subtitle text at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Uniform medium-gray space surrounding the trio at the top and sides.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Neutral gray background and black clothing.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright white for typography and highlights on skin.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Warm skin tones and subtle brown hair highlights.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation with high value contrast between the black garments and white text.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to grays, blacks, and natural skin tones

letterConstructionRules: High stroke contrast between thick and thin lines
characterSpecificRedesigns: Extended horizontal bars on 'L' and 'A' to facilitate overlapping
Interlocking 'A' and 'N' characters in the secondary line
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Size and weight contrast within the same serif family.
graphicDevices: Horizontal rule separating the main title from the subtitle
Layering masks to tuck text behind specific clothing folds

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the high-contrast, elegant serif structure.
Modern digital alternative with similar weight and sharp serifs.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A studio portrait of three people (two men, one woman) in black leather and wool coats, standing close together against a solid medium-gray background. Lighting is dramatic and directional from the side.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large, white, high-contrast serif text in all-caps across the center. The text should be layered so parts of the subjects' clothing appear to be in front of the letters.

verificationChecks: Is the color palette strictly desaturated?
Do the serifs appear sharp and elegant?
Is there a clear hierarchy between the two text blocks?

adjustableVariables: Amount of text overlap on subjects
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the original artists
Any specific brand logos on clothing
postGenerationChecks: Check that text is perfectly horizontal.
Ensure no color bleeding from skin tones into the white text.
Verify that the layering effect looks natural and not digitally forced.
Confirm the gray background is uniform without distracting gradients.
recipe.reuseFormula: Studio portrait of a group + desaturated palette + high-contrast serif display type + layered depth composition.
